summary: Today’s expanded edition covers 92 creative fields, adding game localization and stage lighting, with 789 configured repository queries and 22 model tasks. It contains 51 detailed guides and 185 additional eligible, license-screened discoveries awaiting full profiles. Sixteen guides complete earlier screened entries. Discovery includes recent, newly created and established work; there is no popularity cutoff or daily count quota. Current retained-catalog metadata, 1,187 additional repositories from today’s query union, 535 license-bearing metadata records and targeted source follow-ups were screened beyond the automatic README shortlist. Raw unreviewed and excluded candidates remain local; this is not a claim that every collected candidate was fully reviewed. All featured software grants were reviewed in full, with model weights, fonts/assets, paid services and required proprietary hosts separated. Every item has a dated assessment of licensing, results, setup, maintenance, independent use and dependencies. Unresolved evidence stays Quality unverified; explicit current prototype/instability reasons alone support Experimental. No discovered tool was installed/run, and no new tool is recommended merely for its stars, documentation, test totals or owner demo. Existing weekly library coverage was complete before collection; the new source reviews join that week and will be rechecked in the cumulative library. Verified collection: 789/789 repository queries attempted; 789 successful, 0 partial, 0 failed and 126 bounded/truncated. All 22 model tasks were attempted; 0 failed. These are bounded discovery attempts, not an exhaustive census or quality approval. Separate from successful search queries, 39 watchlist fetches and 3 enrichment attempts failed; the detailed warnings remain in the report. A 404/409 is an availability gap, not proof of abandonment or license revocation.
